units: radiance in the game's linear light units: a white Lambertian surface lit by a source of radiance L over its whole hemisphere shows L; the lightmap's texel v as the game shows it is v^2.2 of these units. Positions in Halo world units (1 wu = 10 ft), z up

fit.how: the tag's lamps at the tag's color x relative power; one scale per lamp group (a shader's surfaces in one 12 wu cell), set so each cell's traced mean light equals the bake's
fit.transport: BSP and the level's scenery/machines, diffuse bounces off their albedos, every bounce
